Olivia Chen: Quick pulse on RCA #452 — we split actions in the doc but need to confirm cross-team owners and due dates before Friday. Link: https://redwood/rca/452 — tagging owners @Raj @Anya @Marco @Sarah
Raj Patel: I'm owner for 'cache warmup' — target due 2026-03-22. Blocker: test infra flakiness on staging; will try to get the env fix by Tue.
Anya Ivanova: I can take 'log retention' cleanup — due 2026-03-24. Need ops to grant me prod log read access (ticket INC-987). @ops-bot can you confirm assignment?
ops-bot: INC-987 assigned to @Sarah Lee, ETA 2026-03-19.
Sarah Lee: Confirmed, I have the ticket and will unblock Anya by 2026-03-19. Also, we should gate the alert-threshold change on Marco's regression pass.
Marco Diaz: Regression test matrix updated; I can run the final pass on 2026-03-20. Will follow-up with the exact test IDs.
Olivia Chen: Thanks. To keep Product happy please paste a single-line owner/due list here so I can close actions quickly. Prefer format: Owner — Item — Due (and blockers).
Raj Patel: Raj Patel — cache warmup script & config — 2026-03-22 — blocked by staging infra flake (tracking in INC-993).
Anya Ivanova: Anya Ivanova — log retention cleanup & backfill — 2026-03-24 — blocked by INC-987 (prod log access).
Marco Diaz: Marco Diaz — alert threshold rollout & regression verification — 2026-03-20 — no blockers.
Sarah Lee: Sarah Lee — prod access grant & verify alert config change — 2026-03-19 — will verify post-change.
Olivia Chen: I'll drop these into the RCA doc and mark owners. If anything slips, flag here. :thumbsup:
Raj Patel: Quick Q — do we want a canary in us-west before global rollout?
Marco Diaz: Yes, add a 10% canary in us-west for 48h. I'll add that to the rollout plan and the runbook.
Anya Ivanova: FYI I also need read access to s3://archive/logs for the retention jobs — Sarah, can you add me to group `prod-read`?
Sarah Lee: Added Anya to `prod-read`; please confirm you can see the bucket in 10m. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: RCA #452 actions doc updated: https://redwood/rca/452/actions — update ts=1836543350
Olivia Chen: One more small ask — let's capture the rollout prereqs in a tiny code block for Product so they can sign off quickly:
```
Owner — Item — Due — Prereqs
Raj — cache warmup — 2026-03-22 — staging fix (INC-993)
Anya — log retention cleanup — 2026-03-24 — prod-read access (INC-987)
Marco — alert rollout & reg tests — 2026-03-20 — test pass + canary plan
Sarah — prod verify & merge — 2026-03-19 — access granted
```
Olivia Chen: If no objections I'll mark actions as 'in-progress' and set a closure target of 2026-03-25. Please flag slips here so Product/Support don't close the RCA prematurely.
Raj Patel: No objections, will update if infra delays persist.
Anya Ivanova: Got it, will post a status update after I confirm access.
Marco Diaz: On it. Will post test run logs here when done.
Sarah Lee: Will confirm verification and post a short summary once done.
Olivia Chen: Great — thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the doc and ping again if Product asks for more detail.
